name: Quinn Yorick
summary: Quinn Yorick is a wounded Forsaken scout sheltering on the upper floor of a ruined farmhouse in the Ivar Patch. Having barely survived an encounter with the ghoul known as Ivar the Foul, he now relies on passing allies to help secure his survival.

sections.title: A Precarious Refuge
sections.body: Tucked away inside an abandoned home at the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick lies gravely injured upstairs. His condition is the result of a vicious clash with Ivar the Foul, a ghoul lurking in the farm's barn in the northern stretches of Silverpine Forest. Sent with his sister Rane to scout Silverpine and report to High Executor Hadrec, Quinn cannot finish his mission or safely retreat alone, so he remains in hiding while travelers working for the Forsaken bring him healing and deal with the creature that nearly tore him apart.

faq.answer: Quinn Yorick can be found hiding on the upper floor of a broken farmhouse in the Ivar Patch, located in Silverpine Forest north of the Sepulcher.
He was severely wounded by Ivar the Foul, a vicious ghoul who lurks in the barn of the farm.

faq.q: What role does Quinn serve for Horde adventurers?
faq.answer: Quinn's sister, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick, sends adventurers to bring him a healing potion. Once he has taken it, she asks them to kill Ivar the Foul so that Quinn has time to recover.

angles.text: Quinn's predicament highlights the ever-present danger the region's ghouls and beasts pose to Forsaken forces attempting to secure northern Silverpine.
